title: Charge Limit
fullStatus: Battery full; Travel remains active while plugged in.
chargingStatus: Charging toward 100%; confirmed by the battery.
notCharging: 100% limit set, but the battery is not charging. Check the charger.
plugIn: AC power is not detected. Plug in a charger to select 100%.
explanation: Travel survives brief cable changes. Five minutes unplugged restores Everyday · %1%, without draining your stored charge.
unsupported: This battery does not expose charge thresholds.
grace: Unplugged: Travel is retained briefly. After five minutes, Everyday returns.
changeFailed: Could not change the charge profile. Check AC power and charge-helper permissions.
care: Avoid heat and prolonged time at full charge. Use Everyday at your desk; select Travel when you need the runtime. Do not deliberately drain the battery to zero. For long storage, about half charge is recommended. Five minutes is a convenience grace period, not a battery-health threshold. Source: Apple battery lifespan guidance; links and limitations in the README.
